facts.fact: Africa Data Centres says its SADC Johannesburg facility hosts the Johannesburg Internet Exchange (JINX), independently operated by INX-ZA, which was expanded into the site so connected members can peer with members in other data centres.
Africa Data Centres says its SADC Cape Town facility hosts the Cape Town Internet Exchange (CINX), independently operated by INX-ZA, which was extended into the site.
Africa Data Centres describes two exchanges operated by INX-ZA in different cities, JINX in Johannesburg and CINX in Cape Town, both in service.
